about: Reference values for VBS (GuestStateIsolationType 1) paravisor images on nucbox-k11, for the custom-VM verifier (enclave-99, docs/security/nucbox-custom-vm-verifier.md check V4). Every value is derived from the pinned bytes and re-checked by windows/vbslike/pkg/pkg.mjs verify on every run; do not edit by hand.
rule: Refuse by EXACT vbsBootDigest only. Never use debugBuild to exclude an image: it follows the manifest's enable_debug and is false for --confidential-debug images too. confidentialDebug is read from the image bytes (OPENHCL_CONFIDENTIAL_DEBUG=1 in the measured command line); such an image trusts the host command line.
eligible: eligible:true marks ONLY the one permitted measured-image reference: at most one image, a non-debug candidate, and a rollover supersedes the old one in the same version. It is PROSPECTIVE and subject to every remaining verification requirement: a report from that image could be admitted only once the paravisor report format is registered and report bytes are pinned and verify under the same boot's IDKS, with the verifier contract's other checks (enclave-99). It grants no production app capacity, no verified or attested status, no badge and no protected-host admission. Custom-report verification stays unsupported and fail-closed: no report format is registered, and no verdict uses this allowlist. A report-level debug indication, if the report has one, is an extra refusal, never a substitute (enclave-99).
notAClaim: No image here is an isolation claim: T0-hv, host_excluded=no. No eligibility here changes host policy: production attach OFF, respawn OFF, recovered VMs HELD.

(i) uefi-dev-boot -LinuxDirect -IsolationType 1 -VbsOptOut, runs 023202, 023514, 023835 and 024124: every boot 'MON boundary t0-hv host_excluded=no hv_isolation=vbs', 'MON yama ptrace_scope=1 -> 2', 'MON ready ... transport=hv_sock', 'DOM front: not dumpable; none of its 3 threads traced', the runtime wasmtime/48.0.1 (id ccadb38a = runtime.json), 'DOM serving'; no status=126; the sentinel's tag appears nowhere on the console (a /panic ends 'DOM1 ERROR runtime exited status=134' and the domain ends; unsolicited upstream bytes appear only as 'DOM front: unsolicited upstream response (N bytes withheld)'); hello-world 1.0.4 served exactly its 13 pinned bytes (03ba204e). (ii) THE MANAGER PATH: manager-accept with this version's manager (control 90eab896) and launcher 10547aca, runs 024240 and 024728: HVLAB-ACCEPT ALL PASS and RESTART-ACCEPT ALL PASS (A0-A9), image 0891c740 on every spawn; the app answered on its own name (200, monitor-signed on the manager-verified key); enclave-csr CN/SAN 4e62e60d.app.enclave.host, SPKI = transportKeySha256 facd5259. NOT RUN: a probe domain and the live-neighbour probe (the dev-boot script did not yet pin this image's probe build; v42 ships the script with it). No report was requested; identity, any report or chain, and host exclusion are NOT established.
